# HarborCommandConsumer
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/HarborCommandConsumer.sol)

**Title:**
HarborCommandConsumer

Abstract base contract for contracts that need to verify whether an
address is an active FleetCommander registered in HarborCommand.

Exposes the `onlyActiveFleetCommander` modifier. Pass a human-readable
label (e.g. "source", "target") so the `InactiveFleetCommander` revert
identifies which vault failed the check.


## State Variables
### HARBOR_COMMAND
The HarborCommand registry used to verify active FleetCommanders.


```solidity
IHarborCommand public immutable HARBOR_COMMAND
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _harborCommand) ;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_harborCommand`|`address`|Address of the deployed HarborCommand registry. Must be non-zero.|


### onlyActiveFleetCommander

Reverts with `InactiveFleetCommander` when `vault` is not an active
FleetCommander according to the HarborCommand registry.


```solidity
modifier onlyActiveFleetCommander(IFleetCommander vault, string memory label) ;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vault`|`IFleetCommander`| The FleetCommander to check.|
|`label`|`string`| Human-readable label for the vault role ("source", "target", …).|


## Errors
### InvalidHarborCommandAddress
Reverts when the provided HarborCommand address is the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidHarborCommandAddress();
```

### InactiveFleetCommander
Reverts when `vault` is not registered as an active FleetCommander.


```solidity
error InactiveFleetCommander(address vault, string label);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vault`|`address`| The vault address that failed the check.|
|`label`|`string`| Human-readable identifier for the vault role (e.g. "source", "target").|
